note: The auditable record of which RPCS3 frame backs which Tier B cell. Authored from what each batch's MANIFEST.md says the frame shows (the manifest section is cited in every note), not from file names. `entries` is the input to work/parity-import.ts; the importer rewrites each entry's `applied` block with the cell, the destination reference and provenance paths, and the source and destination sha256 (identity: the importer copies or hard-links, it never converts). An entry's `replaced` field records a deliberate re-import of the same source into the same cell - the map has been imported four times: twice on 2026-10-27 (batch 1, the second run because the first sidecars carried the manifest's typography and the corpus is ASCII), once later that day with batch 2's four night cells added, and once on 2026-10-28 after work/parity-catalogue.json gained ten states for the settings surfaces batch 2 captured (the Network Settings page, the depth-2 status list, the two message pages, the Theme Settings page and its four choice lists, and the Video Settings page). Each run used --replace, which re-validates and re-copies the batch-1 cells from the same sources (sha256 identical) so only the applied blocks move. Batch 2's frames are night frames, so they are filed at night cells and never at the canonical day cell; see native-xmb/audit/PARITY-SCORECARD.md sections 11 and 12. The images stay under out/parity-references/, which .gitignore excludes, so this file is the committed part: paths and hashes, never firmware pixels. Fifth import (2026-10-28, the day-window batch C:/dev/out/rpcs3-day-2026-10-28): 21 rows added, all theme=original/background=day/resolution=1080p, from a session whose console clock was 10:00 local and whose Date/Time formats were MM/DD + 12-hour on the console - the first batch in this corpus that can occupy a canonical day cell without being mismatch-by-construction on the pin. root is deliberately absent (registered cell, scorecard 10.7).

The frames are imported through importManifest, a byte-faithful copy of the batch manifest (same 30,006 bytes plus exactly one inserted '- Session:' bullet, sha256 above) whose date is the local capture date evidenced by the batch's own logs/refcap-*.log stamps (2026-10-27T22:39 to 23:21) and the section 8 restore audit - 2026-10-27 local is 2026-10-28 UTC, which is the folder name. Only stills are eligible: the bursts are crops of an animated region, not full frames.
